templates.description: Confirms a self-registration and explains that an administrator reviews it.

blocks.text: Gracias por registrarte en {{ brandName }}. Un administrador revisará tu solicitud y te avisaremos por correo cuando esté aprobada.
Si te pedimos confirmar tu correo, hazlo desde el mensaje que te enviamos por separado.

en.subject: We received your registration
en.preheader: An administrator will review it soon.

blocks.text: Thanks for signing up for {{ brandName }}. An administrator will review your request and we will email you once it is approved.
If we asked you to confirm your email, use the separate message we sent you.

templates.description: Single-use link (24 h) that confirms the address belongs to the user.

blocks.text: Confirma que esta dirección te pertenece.
El enlace vence el {{ expiresAt }} y solo funciona una vez.
Si el botón no funciona, copia este enlace en tu navegador: {{ verifyUrl }}
Si no fuiste tú, ignora este mensaje o escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.

en.subject: Confirm your email address
en.preheader: One click and you are done.

blocks.text: Please confirm that this address belongs to you.
The link expires on {{ expiresAt }} and works only once.
If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser: {{ verifyUrl }}
If this wasn't you, ignore this message or write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Tells reviewers that a registration waits for a decision.

description.es: Enlace a la cola de revisión

es.subject: Nueva solicitud de registro: {{ applicantName }}
es.preheader: Hay una cuenta esperando tu revisión.

blocks.text: {{ applicantName }} pidió una cuenta y espera aprobación.

en.subject: New registration request: {{ applicantName }}
en.preheader: An account is waiting for your review.

blocks.text: {{ applicantName }} asked for an account and is waiting for approval.

templates.description: Welcome email once an administrator approves the account.

blocks.text: Un administrador aprobó tu cuenta. Ya puedes iniciar sesión con tu usuario o tu correo.
An administrator approved your account. You can now sign in with your username or email.

templates.description: Sent only when the reviewer chose to notify the applicant.

blocks.text: Revisamos tu solicitud de registro y por ahora no podemos aprobarla.
Si crees que se trata de un error, escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.

en.subject: About your registration
en.preheader: We could not approve your account.

blocks.text: We could not approve your request
We reviewed your registration request and cannot approve it at this time.
If you think this is a mistake, write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Single-use password recovery link.

blocks.text: Recibimos una solicitud para restablecer la contraseña de tu cuenta.
El enlace vence el {{ expiresAt }} y solo funciona una vez. Al cambiarla se cerrarán todas tus sesiones.
Si el botón no funciona, copia este enlace en tu navegador: {{ resetUrl }}
Si no fuiste tú, ignora este mensaje o escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.
We received a request to reset your account password.
The link expires on {{ expiresAt }} and works only once. Changing it signs you out everywhere.
If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser: {{ resetUrl }}
If this wasn't you, ignore this message or write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Security notice after any password change or reset.

blocks.text: La contraseña de tu cuenta cambió el {{ changedAt }}.
Si no fuiste tú, restablécela de inmediato y escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.
Your account password changed on {{ changedAt }}.
If this wasn't you, reset it right away and write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Too many failed sign-ins locked the account temporarily.

blocks.text: Detectamos varios intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión y bloqueamos tu cuenta hasta el {{ lockedUntil }}.
Si fuiste tú y olvidaste tu contraseña, puedes restablecerla; eso también desbloquea la cuenta.
Si no fuiste tú, alguien podría estar intentando entrar. Cambia tu contraseña y avísanos a {{ supportEmail }}.
We noticed several failed sign-in attempts and locked your account until {{ lockedUntil }}.
If it was you and you forgot your password, you can reset it; that also unlocks the account.
If it wasn't you, someone may be trying to get in. Change your password and tell us at {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Sign-in from a device not seen in the last 90 days.

es.subject: Nuevo inicio de sesión en tu cuenta

blocks.text: Alguien inició sesión en tu cuenta desde un dispositivo nuevo.
Si no fuiste tú, cierra esa sesión y cambia tu contraseña.
Someone signed in to your account from a new device.
If it wasn't you, sign that session out and change your password.

templates.description: The baker's quote, with the public link, for their client.

description.es: Nombre del repostero o del negocio

es.subject: {{ bakerName }} te envió la cotización {{ quoteNumber }}

blocks.text: {{ bakerName }} preparó una cotización para ti. Puedes revisarla, aceptarla o rechazarla en línea.
Si el botón no funciona, copia este enlace en tu navegador: {{ quoteUrl }}
{{ bakerName }} prepared a quote for you. You can review, accept or decline it online.
If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser: {{ quoteUrl }}

templates.description: The client accepted from the public link; the baker should schedule the order.

es.subject: {{ clientName }} aceptó la cotización {{ quoteNumber }}
es.preheader: Agenda el pedido en tu calendario.

blocks.text: {{ clientName }} aceptó tu cotización. Agenda el pedido para no perder la fecha.

en.subject: {{ clientName }} accepted quote {{ quoteNumber }}
en.preheader: Schedule the order in your calendar.

blocks.text: {{ clientName }} accepted your quote. Schedule the order so the date is not missed.

templates.description: Confirms to the client that the quote was accepted.

description.es: Nombre del repostero o del negocio
Fecha del evento, con formato (puede estar vacía)

blocks.text: La cotización {{ quoteNumber }} de {{ bakerName }} quedó aceptada.
{{ bakerName }} se pondrá en contacto contigo para los detalles de la entrega.
Quote {{ quoteNumber }} from {{ bakerName }} is now accepted.
{{ bakerName }} will contact you about the delivery details.

templates.description: An open quote expires in two days or less.

description.es: Enlace al detalle de la cotización

es.subject: La cotización {{ quoteNumber }} está por vencer

blocks.text: La cotización {{ quoteNumber }} para {{ clientName }} vence el {{ validUntil }} y aún no tiene respuesta.

en.subject: Quote {{ quoteNumber }} is about to expire

blocks.text: Quote {{ quoteNumber }} for {{ clientName }} expires on {{ validUntil }} and has no answer yet.

templates.description: Reminder before an order, with the production sheet link.

description.es: Enlace a la hoja de producción

templates.description: Tells the client the date and place of their order.

description.es: Nombre del repostero o del negocio

templates.description: An administrator created the account; the link sets the first password.

blocks.text: Se creó una cuenta para ti. Define tu contraseña para empezar.
Si el botón no funciona, copia este enlace en tu navegador: {{ activationUrl }}
An account was created for you. Choose your password to get started.
If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser: {{ activationUrl }}

templates.description: An administrator assigned a temporary password that must be changed at sign-in.

blocks.text: Un administrador te asignó una contraseña temporal. Deberás cambiarla al iniciar sesión.
Si no fuiste tú, ignora este mensaje o escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.

en.subject: Your temporary {{ brandName }} password
en.preheader: Change it when you sign in.

blocks.text: An administrator assigned you a temporary password. You will have to change it when you sign in.
If this wasn't you, ignore this message or write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Notice to the previous address that the account email changed.

blocks.text: El correo de tu cuenta se cambió a {{ newEmail }}.
Si no fuiste tú, avisa a un administrador o escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.
Your account email was changed to {{ newEmail }}.
If this wasn't you, tell an administrator or write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: Two-step verification was turned off and other sessions were closed.

es.subject: Desactivaste la verificación en dos pasos

blocks.text: La verificación en dos pasos de tu cuenta se desactivó y se cerraron tus otras sesiones.
Si no fuiste tú, avisa a un administrador.
Two-step verification was turned off for your account and your other sessions were closed.
If this wasn't you, tell an administrator.

templates.description: Someone signed in with a recovery code.

es.subject: Se usó un código de respaldo

blocks.text: Inicio de sesión con código de respaldo
Alguien inició sesión en tu cuenta con un código de respaldo. Te quedan {{ remainingCodes }}.
Si no fuiste tú, cambia tu contraseña y avisa a un administrador.
Someone signed in to your account with a recovery code. You have {{ remainingCodes }} left.
If this wasn't you, change your password and tell an administrator.

templates.description: Someone tried to register with an address that already has an account (never revealed to them).

es.subject: Alguien intentó registrarse con tu correo

blocks.text: Alguien intentó crear una cuenta nueva con tu correo. No creamos ninguna cuenta.
Si fuiste tú, inicia sesión con tu cuenta actual o restablece tu contraseña.
Si no fuiste tú, ignora este mensaje o escríbenos a {{ supportEmail }}.

en.subject: Someone tried to register with your email

blocks.text: Someone tried to create a new account with your email. No account was created.
If it was you, sign in with your existing account or reset your password.
If this wasn't you, ignore this message or write to {{ supportEmail }}.

templates.description: A recipe was shared with an email recipient.

description.es: Días que el enlace sigue vigente

blocks.text: {{ senderName }} compartió la receta «{{ recipeName }}» contigo.
El enlace está disponible durante {{ expirationDays }} días.
Si el botón no funciona, copia este enlace en tu navegador: {{ shareUrl }}

en.subject: {{ senderName }} shared a recipe with you

blocks.text: A recipe was shared with you
{{ senderName }} shared the recipe “{{ recipeName }}” with you.
The link is available for {{ expirationDays }} days.
If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser: {{ shareUrl }}
